english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(2)(a) and 9 of the Deer Act 1991.

english.notes:
(i) See section 1(3) for exceptions.
(ii) If more than one deer is involved in a single offence the fine shall be determined as if the person convicted has been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each deer.
(iii) See also offence wording: H4034.
(iv) Time limit on Prosecutions - Section 9(3) of the Deer Act 1991 provides that proceedings for an offence may be brought within the period of 6 months beginning with the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to warrant the proceedings came to his knowledge.
(v) Forfeiture - Section 13 of the Act provides the courts with powers to order the forfeiture of vehicles, animals, weapons and other things and to disqualify offenders from holding a game dealers licence.
(vi) Disqualification - Section 13(2) of the Act provides that where a person is convicted of this offence, the court (in addition to any other penalty), may disqualify that person for holding or obtaining a licence to deal in game for such period as the court thinks fit and may cancel any firearm or shotgun certificate held by him.
